info.title: Global Health AI Sandbox proposed API
info.description: Implementation contract baseline. Closed first-workflow resources and all 40 command inputs. Capability activation and later-slice gates are in contract_activation.json. No running service is supplied.

post.summary: Draft application; invalid legal references rejected
post.description: Server-issued applicant context only; legal reference validation; does not confer institutional privilege.

post.summary: Pending invitation; delegation and self-elevation checked
post.description: Current verified institution, delegable role subset and scope, positive expiry; recipient cannot activate own privilege.

post.summary: Effective restriction and impact tasks within revocation target
post.description: Lock subject membership; prevent removing last owner without accepted successor; apply online revocation target.

post.summary: Frozen submission; quarantine or missing materials block review
post.description: Exact component versions, quarantine clearance, provider rights and selected execution-mode prerequisites.

post.summary: Review package; discovery rights and scope validated
post.description: Discoverable exact dataset release; study reference and purpose; requested interval positive; no implied grant.

post.summary: Grant or denial; independence and all required rights checked
post.description: Snapshot current; independent required owners; approved scope subset of request and all rights; approved_scope required only for approval.

post.summary: Quarantined import identity and controlled transfer route
post.description: Current grant, approved source and mapping; transfer enters quarantine; no preview or search before clearance.

post.summary: Reconciled batch; missing inputs or integrity mismatch block acceptance
post.description: Expected source digest and bytes; accepted + rejected + quarantined = source; counts nonnegative; no omitted records.

post.summary: Immutable manifest; leakage or quality blockers prevent release
post.description: Immutable manifest, label quality, leakage/partition checks, rights, eligible quality decisions; sealed labels remain separate.

post.summary: Frozen protocol; missing clinical rules or stale review blocked
post.description: All endpoints, thresholds, sample and subgroup methods, failure rules, uncertainty and stop criteria complete and approved.

post.summary: Active study record; all applicable prerequisites rechecked
post.description: Ready state; exact frozen protocol/config; G1/G2 and all applicable G4/G7/G8; current grants, owners, budget; no holds.

post.summary: Logical run plus attempt; same request deduplicated
post.description: Lock study and budget; exact immutable manifest; active grants and allowed region/egress; admitted resource profile; reserve budget atomically.

post.summary: Cancellation intent followed by observed result; no assumed remote stop
post.description: Authorised run scope; terminal observations preserved; append intent then await observed termination; settle usage once.

post.summary: Disclosure and rights review package; no immediate unrestricted link
post.description: Exact assets, intended recipient/purpose; rights and disclosure review task; cannot directly create unrestricted delivery.

post.summary: Immutable issued report and status identity; incomplete provenance blocked
post.description: G3; frozen dossier, complete failures and deviations, claim provenance and eligible independent signers; immutable issued artifact.

post.summary: Released view; changed bytes or recipients require renewed decision
post.description: Separately approved audience and exact sanitized bytes; current rights and report status; confidential titles excluded.

post.summary: Dispatch record and independent receipt state
post.description: Verified channel/recipient, previewed immutable package and human authority; durable dispatch then separate receipt.

post.summary: Immediate case and triage task; missing optional facts do not block
post.description: Any authenticated reporter may submit concern alone; other fields optional; attachment quarantine must not block initial intake.

post.summary: Active restriction and impact records; historical evidence retained
post.description: Immediate authorised scope containment; record independent hold owner and reason; create impact tasks.

post.summary: Resume only after all applicable holds and gates pass
post.description: Every applicable hold independently cleared, remediation verified, prerequisites refreshed; return only to prior valid state.

post.summary: Site-specific authorisation; evaluation result alone insufficient
post.description: G5 for exact site/use/configuration; verified local permission, buyer acceptance, training, fallback and funding.

post.summary: Version observation and mismatch review where required
post.description: Authenticated observed source and event time; observation cannot itself authorise deployment; mismatches trigger review.

post.summary: Validated observation or quarantine; duplicate events reconciled
post.description: Current admitted source/plan; unique source event ID; finite observed values, null for missing statuses; retain event and receipt time.

post.summary: Unverified record until qualified verification completes
post.description: Issuer evidence and positive validity interval; record as unverified; no automatic regulatory authority.

post.summary: Hold-aware assessment; no immediate destructive bypass
post.description: Approved retention basis, dependency inventory and legal-hold assessment; request creates assessment, never immediate deletion.

post.summary: Scoped closure attestation with explicit residual duties
post.description: Accepted handover, inventory, revocations, retention and residual duties; cannot orphan incidents or held records.

post.summary: Freeze review snapshot and assign required review slots
post.description: Freeze review snapshot and assign required review slots. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.summary: Append attributed decision bound to exact snapshot; reject conflict or stale evidence
post.description: Append attributed decision bound to exact snapshot; reject conflict or stale evidence. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.summary: Apply registered transition under current guards; arbitrary state editing rejected
post.description: Apply registered transition under current guards; arbitrary state editing rejected. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.summary: Activate delegated scope only after independent approval
post.description: Activate delegated scope only after independent approval. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.summary: Record effective revocation and bounded propagation tasks
post.description: Record effective revocation and bounded propagation tasks. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.summary: Mark independently verified evidence and exact applicable scope
post.description: Mark independently verified evidence and exact applicable scope. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.summary: Issue controlled delivery for exact approved bytes and recipient
post.description: Issue controlled delivery for exact approved bytes and recipient. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.summary: Create new safe attempt; preserve prior attempts and enforce retry limit
post.description: Create new safe attempt; preserve prior attempts and enforce retry limit. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.summary: Append authenticated observation; do not infer state from delivery alone
post.description: Append authenticated observation; do not infer state from delivery alone. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.description: Link immutable successor and append public status correction. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

post.description: Apply approved configuration version at effective time. Apply the registered domain transition and independent decision rules; generic role membership alone is insufficient.

put.description: Exact byte range derived from index; no Content-Encoding; service hashes received bytes before durable acknowledgement. Same part/hash is idempotent. Current rights checked for every PUT.

study_ref.description: Study UUID in active tenant, or custodian-owned verified external_reference of kind study. Never an unchecked remote UUID.

TransitionResourceRequest.description: Study transitions only in contract 1.1. Exact source state machine and guards are in study_transition_registry.json. Other resource types return E_CAPABILITY_DISABLED until their registered transition schema exists.

ResourcePatch.description: Replace title and/or the COMPLETE closed payload. Omission preserves a field; null is allowed only where declared. Merge of arbitrary nested keys is forbidden. Frozen versions cannot be patched.

study_ref.description: Study UUID in active tenant, or custodian-owned verified external_reference of kind study. Never an unchecked remote UUID.

ResourcePayload.description: Registered first-workflow payloads. Domain must equal the mapping in contract_activation.json. No generic payload fallback.
